newsitem.title: ROMANIA: PLANE MAKER NEWCOMER ON BUCHAREST BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: PLANE MAKER NEWCOMER ON BUCHAREST BOURSE.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse said on Thursday the number of its listings would rise to 48 on Friday, when one more company joins in trading on the second tier.
The newcomer is Aeroteh, a Bucharest-based airplane equipment maker. Its share capital is 17.4 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 25,000 lei each, a stock exchange statement said.
The State Ownership Fund is Aeroteh's majority stockholder with a 68.6 percent stake and individual shareholders acquired 31.38 percent in a mass selloff. Managers have the rest.
Aeroteh last year had a net profit of 532.7 million lei, up from 98.7 million in 1995.
The Bucharest stock exchange trades eight companies on the first tier. ($=7,148 lei)
